plugins.name: Service Inventory
plugins.description: Discover infrastructure resources and control registered service access through a separate controller.
plugins.author: Service Inventory contributors
features: Discover Dokploy apps, Docker containers and Proxmox VM/LXC resources
Keep source availability separate when a platform is unavailable
Control registered HTTP services through a dedicated access controller
Prepare fresh access plans, apply changes and restore previous routing
Keep credentials in central backend settings and record administrative operations

versions.notes: Independent inventory sources and registered HTTP service access. No deployment-specific data.
